 Trending Jenna Johnson Dances With a Broken Nose During ‘DWTS’ Grammy Night
 The professional dancer nose the show must go on. Updated   Nov. 10, 2026, 9:18 PM EST / Source : TODAY Liz Calvario
 Senior Editor
 Jenna Johnson shares how she broke her nose ahead of "DWTS" Grammy Night. Instagram/Jenna Johnson Share Add TODAY to Google Jenna Johnson *nose* the show must go on, even after a brutal injury. 
 The “Dancing With the Stars” pro shared that she suffered a broken nose ahead of the Nov. 10 Grammy Night episode. 
 “Alright, you guys. So, last night I definitely broke my nose during camera blocking,” Johnson said in an Instagram video. “If you can see this right side, right here and right here, a little swollen.”
 “No black eyes today, which is awesome. But if my nose looks four times its size, that’s why,” she added with a thumbs up.
 Johnson, who is partnered with actor Harry Shum Jr. captioned her video: “Salsa: 1, Jenna’s Nose: 0. Happy Show Day.”
 Fellow pros hyped her up and sent well wishes, including Emma Slater who wrote, “You’re a beast. Like seriously.”
 Dylan Efron, who competed last season, added, “Don’t need noses to dance 💪crush it tonight!”
 Her partner Shum Jr. also commented, “WHO DID THIS TO YOU?? ….oh…sorry…BUT YOU ARE A TOTAL BADASS!!!!”
 Johnson’s husband and fellow pro Valentin Chmerkovskiy added, “1of1 ❤️ still a baddie.”
 During the “DWTS” episode, co-host Julianne Hough asked Johnson how she was feeling after her injury. 
 “I did break my nose but I feel amazing. I’m so happy that I get to dance,” she said, as Shum Jr. apologized to her. 
 “It’s OK,” she replied. “Salsa elbow, it’s fine.”
 The couple didn’t have anything to worry about after the judges gave them a 29 out of 30 for their salsa routine to “Die with A Smile” by Lady Gaga and Bruno Mars.
 With only three episodes left of Season 30 of “DWTS,” the stakes are high. Johnson and Shum Jr., however, continue to be at the top of the leaderboard, as are Chmerkovskiy and Jenna Dewan. 
 When speaking to TODAY.com in October, the husband and wife shared that there is no competition between them.
 “I’ve never been competitive with Jenna. I’m only passionate about creating, only passionate about my art or my work or the effort that I put into ‘Dancing With the Stars,’” Chmerkovskiy said. “So, it’s not a competition of, can I do it better than her? The competition is, can I produce my best work? And I think both of us can do that. I could support her and be ‘competitive’ at the same time.”
